verdict.rationale: Instinct's own docs say users can call the assistant, and that it may proactively call them and collect voice data, so a voice channel exists. The evidence never shows the user's voice conversations being natural or real-time. The praised 'calls' feature is the agent phoning third parties such as restaurants, not the user talking with it. Missing for 10: evidence of natural, low-latency real-time conversation quality, documentation of the voice-call experience itself, and hands-on corroboration of a user talking with the assistant by voice.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: You can text or call it.
The Services may also collect audio and voice data, should you choose to enable these features.
